text: sorry what are the operations for those i dont have the code pulled up; anything that looks like it has been superceeded likely is, but anything that is just loosely hanging around is likely because no onen ever wired it up, i cant really think of anything that we have ever added and then outright removed without some related replacement of it
resolution: Traced each previously identified unreachable 3D operation through its introduction, later call-site removals, and current replacement path so the list distinguishes retired implementation from genuinely missing wiring. The audit found one real unwired support path: retopology band inheritance is implemented and unit-tested but is not connected to topology edits that already emit source-face provenance. Everything else is a superseded implementation, redundant getter or wrapper, test-only relic, or intentional hot-reload compatibility cleanup; no source files were changed.
